відповідь.body: {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"version\":\"1\",\"text\":\"I built this for your walk to the office in deep frost and snow: the fur coat leads, with the beanie and scarf finishing it. The sweater is one slim layer under the coat on such a cold day, so I kept the scarf at your neck and the beanie on your head, and you take them off once you are inside. The brown sweater and the brown bag stay in one quiet colour, and the grey check trousers give the outfit a business tone. The fitted sweater under the wide trousers leaves a single line of volume, so even with the long coat the silhouette stays clean.\",\"how_to_wear\":[\"Wrap the scarf around your neck over the sweater's turtleneck and keep it under the coat.\",\"Pull the beanie down over your hair for the walk and take it off at the office.\",\"Keep the coat closed outside and open it in the office, so the sweater and the check trousers show.\"],\"wrong_photos\":[],\"swap\":{\"item\":\"#451·06\",\"why\":\"day\"},\"named\":[{\"n\":\"#56·33\",\"what\":\"brown turtleneck sweater\"},{\"n\":\"#274·25\",\"what\":\"grey check wide trousers\"},{\"n\":\"#1·37\",\"what\":\"fur coat\"},{\"n\":\"#287·45\",\"what\":\"brown bag\"},{\"n\":\"#520·36\",\"what\":\"scarf\"},{\"n\":\"#353·09\",\"what\":\"beanie\"}],\"about_items\":[{\"n\":\"#56·33\",\"text\":\"A fitted turtleneck suits a work day. Under the coat it keeps your torso slim and tidy, so the volume sits only in the trousers.\"},{\"n\":\"#274·25\",\"text\":\"Wide check trousers give your office day a business tone and a long, straight line down the legs.\"},{\"n\":\"#1·37\",\"text\":\"This is the main layer for your walk in deep frost and snow. Its length gives you one long vertical line over the whole outfit.\"},{\"n\":\"#451·06\",\"text\":\"The tall shaft and kitten heel would stretch your leg line under the wide trousers. The open toe does not suit snow and deep frost on a walk, so I would replace it with a closed pair of the same kind.\"},{\"n\":\"#287·45\",\"text\":\"A roomy shoulder bag fits your work things, and its brown ties in with the sweater.\"},{\"n\":\"#520·36\",\"text\":\"The scarf closes the neck between the coat and the turtleneck, which makes up for the thin layer under the coat on this frosty walk.\"},{\"n\":\"#353·09\",\"text\":\"The beanie covers your head on the snowy walk to work and is easy to take off once you are in the office.\"}]}"}],"usage":{"input_tokens":14704,"output_tokens":2703},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
